source.note: Curated clinical equivalences. Each pair is a deliberate editorial claim, not a derived fact.
source.direction: Pairs are one-way. 'from' is what the clinic asked for; 'to' is what may be offered instead when nothing of the asked-for kind passes the screening. The reverse of a pair is only listed when it is separately true, and neither pair below is: a clinic that asked for the mobile or portable device needs the portability and the low power draw, which the fixed installation it would be offered in return does not have.
source.review: Adding a pair here is a clinical claim about what a clinic may treat with. Nothing is added without a named reason.

pairs.reason: Does the same clinical job for chest radiography and runs on single-phase supply.
Same imaging for obstetric and point-of-care use, at lower power and with no fixed installation.
